title: Scanning for G6 failes after some time
body:
I'm using latest nightly 20190530 and after some time (hours or even one day) xDrip fails to connect to the G6. When I hit "restart collector" manually the connection is established the next time the sensor wakes up.
When this happens the status is either "initializing connection" or "scanning".

I tried all G6 debug options but the behavior doesn't change.
